theme_description: High-End Dark Mode Technical. Focuses on premium energy analytics SaaS aesthetic. Uses deep obsidian/slate backgrounds with vibrant, electric green accents (representing energy, savings, and sustainability). Minimalist glassmorphism for floating elements, high contrast for data legibility.

headings.style: tracking-tight, bold, expressive. Never use Inter for headings.

layouts.container: Max-width 7xl, massive padding (p-8 to p-24) to let the design breathe.
layouts.hero: Asymmetrical Grid. Left side: 60% width with large dynamic typography (Account for every watt). Right side: 40% width featuring the 3D rotating URJA-CHAKRA logo placeholder and glowing animated energy flow.
layouts.dashboard_demo: Dense Bento Grid (Mode B). Tight gaps (gap-4). Cards with 1px border-white/10 and subtle glassmorphism (bg-white/5).
layouts.solution_flow: Circular or staggered horizontal timeline utilizing Framer Motion to draw lines and animate 'energy pulses' between steps.

components_to_use.UI: Shadcn UI (Card, Button, Tabs, Table, Dialog, Badge, ScrollArea). Heavily customize to remove standard 'Vercel' look (use darker backgrounds, colored neon borders on hover).
components_to_use.Charts: Recharts for Actual vs Baseline graphs and Anomaly spike graphs in the Demo and Tech sections.
components_to_use.Icons: lucide-react for standard UI, @phosphor-icons/react for high-end duotone elements.
components_to_use.Animation: framer-motion for page reveals, energy flows, and UI transitions.
components_to_use.3D: @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei for the 3D rotating logo placeholder.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 for sticky headers and dashboard cards.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.5)] on key elements like UEC values, Wallet balance, and primary CTA buttons.
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Implement animated gradient borders for the 'Investigate' anomaly card to draw attention.

hero_background.description: Landscape factory background. Use with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/70) or gradient mask to provide deep industrial context without overwhelming the UI.

demo_context.description: Steel rolling mill interior for Sharma Steel Rolling Mills dashboard header or background.

impact_section.description: Wind turbine on a building, representing sustainable energy and reinvestment.

specific_section_instructions.Hero: Must feature 'Account for every watt.' Prominent 'Launch Interactive Demo' button. Create a sophisticated Right side layout where an animated flow shows Factory -> Smart Meter -> Energy Analytics -> Verified Savings -> UEC -> Green Wallet. In the same view, integrate a R3F Canvas showing a 3D rotating metallic/glass coin or ring labeled 'URJA-CHAKRA' and 'ऊर्जा चक्र' with a green glow.
specific_section_instructions.Demo: Simulate the state exactly as requested: 'Sharma Steel Rolling Mills'. Show anomaly 'Line 2 compressor 34% above baseline'. Button to 'Investigate' which expands the anomaly details. Button to 'Implement Improvement' which triggers a deterministic sequence: energy drops, 'energy saving verified', UEC goes up by 12, Wallet updates to ₹1.28L. Must use React state to handle this simulation.
specific_section_instructions.Technology: Show 5 layers: EDGE, INGEST, STORE, INTELLIGENCE, APPLICATION. Make them hoverable cards that reveal their purpose.
specific_section_instructions.Branding: Use 'URJA-CHAKRA' and 'ऊर्जा चक्र' everywhere exactly as specified. Do NOT alter the Hindi spelling.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark backgrounds has at least a 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the 3D logo and continuous energy flow animations.
accessibility.testing: All key interactive elements (Demo buttons, Nav links, Investigate buttons) MUST have data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold: use radical asymmetrical layouts for marketing sections.
Do NOT apply global 'transition: all'. Use targeted transitions.
NEVER center-align entire containers (no text-align: center on App).
Use 2-3x more spacing than usual. Let elements breathe (py-24, gap-12).
Ensure the Demo section looks like a distinct, high-end SaaS embedded inside the marketing page. Use smaller fonts, tighter grids, and real-looking mock data.

Implement the 3D Logo using `@react-three/fiber`, `@react-three/drei` (e.g., using a rotating `Torus` or `Cylinder` with `Text` applied, styled beautifully with meshPhysicalMaterial, metalness, roughness, and glowing lights).
